title: Wire UX SOS events to the SOS dispatch primitive
description: After the priority-aware SOS L2 primitive lands, register an app-level lichen_ux_button handler for SOS_ARM and SOS_DEDICATED. Compose canonical sos_alert CBOR, sign with the node identity and monotonic origin sequence, and send through the primitive. Add independent tests for both button events, signing, and priority.
notes: Released: explicit prerequisite project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.168.1 (priority-aware L2 SOS dispatch primitive) is still open; this slice cannot be implemented coherently before that API lands.
